fix.summary: Set The First Thru-Hike Guide to $0 and remove its $4.99 unlock step so the Download button gives the free instant download the ad promises.
fix.rationale: The ad promises a free instant download, but the post-email page says "Unlock it for $4.99," so the funnel paywall breaks the promise.
steps: Store admin > Guides > The First Thru-Hike Guide > Price: change $4.99 to $0 and disable the payment/unlock step.
Same guide > Delivery settings: set the Download button to deliver the file immediately after email submission.
Save, then check by opening the ad URL, submitting an email, and confirming the guide downloads free with no $4.99 prompt.
